title: Conformal Prediction Intervals & Uncertainty Calibration
academic_interpretation: Rather than issuing a single pseudo-precise price forecast, empirical conformal residuals from the validation fold construct calibrated 90% and 95% prediction intervals. On the untouched test set, the empirical 90% interval achieved 80.4% coverage, and the 95% interval achieved 90.7% coverage, demonstrating reliable out-of-sample calibration.
